x: Of our lads at this time the two Freds—Bentley and Rickards—were together in tenth position, Martin fourteenth, and Paul Khlopin well up. Approaching Croydon, Whitlock drew level with Stone, and shortly afterwards went ahead.

Khlopin worked his way through to 7th and when they came into sight again was 5th but was unable to improve on his position.
